batches.title: Fase 2: Protocolos com Baixa Completude (<25%) Decodificados do Binário SWGEmu.exe
batches.description: Engenharia reversa sistemática e desmontagem estática x86 das rotinas de desempacotamento de 11 protocolos de rede de jogo com status pendente (<25%), abrangendo combate espacial, mísseis, colisões dinâmicas, suporte ao jogador (CSR) e Scripted User Interface (SUI).
batches.methodology: Rastreamento de RTTI (.?AV<Class>@@) -> CompleteObjectLocator -> Virtual Table -> Construtor ReadIterator (0x0118b740) -> Registro de AutoVariables (0x0118b5f0).

packets.name: DestroyShipComponentMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra 3 Archive::AutoVariable membros: AutoVariable<NetworkId> NetworkId (+0x2c), AutoVariable<int> ComponentIndex (+0x3c) e AutoVariable<float> Severity (+0x4c).

packets.name: DestroyShipMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra 2 Archive::AutoVariable membros: AutoVariable<NetworkId> NetworkId (+0x2c) e AutoVariable<float> Severity (+0x3c).

packets.name: HyperspaceMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra 1 Archive::AutoVariable membro: AutoVariable<NetworkId> NetworkId (+0x2c).

packets.name: PlayClientEffectObjectTransformMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<std::string> EffectName (+0x2c), AutoVariable<NetworkId> TargetId (+0x48) e AutoVariable<Transform> LocalTransform (+0x58).

packets.name: PlayClientEventLocMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<std::string> EventName (+0x2c), AutoVariable<std::string> SceneName (+0x48), AutoVariable<Vector> Location (+0x64) e AutoVariable<NetworkId> CellId (+0x7c).

packets.name: PlayClientEventObjectMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<std::string> EventName (+0x2c), AutoVariable<std::string> HardpointName (+0x48) e AutoVariable<NetworkId> TargetId (+0x64).

packets.name: ShipUpdateTransformCollisionMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<NetworkId> ShipId (+0x2c), AutoVariable<Transform> Transform (+0x3c), AutoVariable<Vector> Velocity (+0x74) e AutoVariable<unsigned long> SyncStamp (+0x8c).

packets.name: UpdateMissileMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<NetworkId> NetworkId (+0x2c), AutoVariable<int> WeaponIndex (+0x3c), AutoVariable<int> TargetComponent (+0x4c) e AutoVariable<int> Status (+0x5c).

packets.name: CreateTicketResponseMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<unsigned int> TicketId (+0x2c) e AutoVariable<unsigned int> ResultCode (+0x3c).

packets.name: GetCommentsResponseMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<unsigned int> TicketId (+0x2c) e AutoArray<CustomerServiceComment> (+0x40). Serialização de CustomerServiceComment verificada em 0x00b1cbc0.

packets.name: SuiUpdatePageMessage
packets.reversal_details: Desempacota PageId e aplica vetor delta de propriedades AutoDeltaVariable<SuiPageData>.

batches.title: Fase 1: Reversão Central de Controladores e Mensagens Top-Level
batches.description: Engenharia reversa inicial de mensagens de rede e mapeamento completo da tabela central ControllerMessageFactory (0x00b0cfc0 / 0x00b0d190) para o despachante ObjControllerMessage (0x80CE5E46).
batches.methodology: Desmonte de ControllerMessageFactory::registerMessage (0x00b0cfc0) e construtores de GameNetworkMessage.

packets.name: AddMapLocationMessage
packets.reversal_details: Registra 7 Archive::AutoVariable membros: PlanetName, NetworkId, LocationName, X, Z, LocationType e SubCategory.

packets.name: ObjectMenuSelectMessage::MESSAGE_TYPE
packets.reversal_details: Registra AutoVariable<NetworkId> TargetObjectId (+0x38) e AutoVariable<unsigned char> SelectedMenuItem (+0x48).
